headline: Sensex and Nifty Surge Nearly 1,000 Points as Auto and Bank Stocks Lead Market Recovery

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Strong buying interest in auto and banking sectors powered a major afternoon rally
Robust FII inflows boosted investor confidence despite global cues
Markets recovered from an initial gap-down caused by US Fed rate hike concerns
Broad-based buying across key sectors helped indices reclaim psychological resistance levels
whatHappening: Sensex jumped 990 points to cross the 83,000 mark during the trading session
Nifty 50 reclaimed the 25,500 level after starting the day lower
Bajaj Group-backed BIHS announced a ₹2,500 crore investment in a healthcare venture
Bank of Baroda launched a new financing scheme for electric vehicle infrastructure
summary: Indian markets staged a dramatic recovery with the Sensex surging nearly 1,000 points to reclaim the 83,000 level. The rally was driven by strong performance in auto and bank stocks alongside significant FII inflows. Despite early pressure from Fed rate hike signals, broad-based buying pushed the Nifty back above 25,500.
